research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Fleetzero is focused on developing a containerized battery system designed for integration into cargo ships. This system includes a container, framework, battery cells, and an electrical coupling, allowing for easy installation and removal from a vessel's container space. The framework within the container defines multiple compartments, facilitating efficient energy storage and management. This innovation aligns with Fleetzero's goal of creating battery electric cargo ships to decarbonize ocean freight.

overview_description.description:
To deliver freight for our customers, Fleetzero is developing a fleet of electric ships without any green bonus. The company's vessels, unlike giant container ships, can be built inexpensively in domestic shipyards, which enables us to operate in regulated markets where ships must be built in the country they are traveling through.

Fleetzero was established in 2021 in Auburn, Alabama.

product.name: Electric Cargo Ships
product.description: Fleetzero designs and operates electric cargo ships intended for zero-emission ocean freight.

product.name: Leviathan Energy Storage System
product.description: A marine energy storage solution optimized for zero-emission and high-energy operation of large vessels, scalable from 200 kWh to hundreds of Megawatt-hours.

product.name: Battery Swapping Technology
product.description: Fleetzero's ships utilize a rapid battery swapping technology to enable long-distance ocean travel without long charging times.

product.name: Hybrid Ship Retrofitting
product.description: Retrofitting services for existing ships to operate as low-emissions hybrid vessels using Fleetzero's battery technology.
